environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'data-pipeline-prod' with service account 'stream-processor-prod-sa'. The IAM role (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/StreamProcessorProdRole) has an attached permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:policy/DataPipelineBoundary) that includes an explicit Deny on kafka:CreateTopic and kafka:Produce for any topic ARN matching 'arn:aws:kafka:*:*:topic/*/admin-*'. Additionally, the MSK cluster has a resource policy requiring kafka:RequestContext/TopicName to not match 'admin-*' unless the principal's session tag 'elevated' equals 'true'. The pod's IRSA token does not carry this session tag. A Service Control Policy (id: scp-0a1b2c3d4e) at the OU level denies kafka:Produce when aws:ResourceTag/sensitivity equals 'privileged' and the principal does not have a permission boundary that explicitly allows it - creating a circular deny. The 'admin-commands' topic is tagged sensitivity=privileged in MSK.

config.scp: scp-0a1b2c3d4e denies kafka:Produce on sensitivity=privileged without session tag
config.msk_resource_policy: denies produce to admin-* topics without elevated=true session tag
config.network_policy: allow egress to MSK broker endpoints only
